evidence: Sales LAN cannot reach the data-center 192.168.80.0/24 network.
Topology shows Sales -> R8 -> R9 -> data center.
R8 show ip route displays static route S 192.168.80.0/24 [1/0] via 10.8.89.9.
R8 interface Gi0/1 is up with IP 10.8.89.1 and R9 link address is 10.8.89.2.
The static route next-hop 10.8.89.9 does not match the neighbor adjacency IP 10.8.89.2.
root_cause: The static route to 192.168.80.0/24 on R8 points to an incorrect next-hop IP (10.8.89.9) that does not match the neighbor adjacency IP (10.8.89.2).
verification: Run show ip route on R8 to confirm the route to 192.168.80.0/24 uses the correct next hop 10.8.89.2.
Test reachability from the Sales LAN to the 192.168.80.0/24 data-center network.
fix_steps: Verify the current static route configuration on R8 using show running-config or show ip route.
Remove the incorrect static route pointing to next-hop 10.8.89.9.
Configure the corrected static route for 192.168.80.0/24 pointing to the correct neighbor adjacency IP 10.8.89.2.
Verify that the updated route is correctly installed in R8's routing table.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: show ip route on R8 specifies next-hop IP that does not match neighbor adjacency IP.
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Reconfigure route on R8 to use correct next-hop interface IP.
